sources.finding: SSKJ headword ukulela, feminine -e; example igrati na ukulelo. Search excerpt actually read.

Primary Slovenian teaching abstract and article use ukulela as singular instrument noun; prose supports accusative ukulelo and locative ukuleli. The article title Ukulele v vrtcu is plural, not evidence that the singular feminine noun is indeclinable.
